paragraphs.source_en: The moment she stepped into the street, a seething air of death struck her full in the face. There were more people abroad than usual. The authorities had already announced the route by which Mitsunari and the others would be taken to the execution ground: they would leave the Shoshidai residence at Horikawa-Demizu, pass through the crossroads, proceed along Muromachi into Teramachi, then cross the capital to the riverbed at Rokujō. Though nothing was visibly amiss, Osode somehow felt that every face she encountered was filled with bloodlust.
